topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation, framing how previously introduced immune components interact to generate immune reactions.

topics.label: Innate recognition of pathogens and cellular damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infections and cellular injury through molecular patterns, pattern recognition receptor families, and inflammasome signaling.

topics.label: Leukocyte recruitment, trafficking, and systemic inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells direct leukocyte recruitment, migration through tissues and lymphatics, and the systemic consequences of widespread inflammatory activation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the immune system shuts down acute inflammatory responses, coordinates tissue healing, and manages persistent or chronic inflammatory conditions such as granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and announces the subject of the subsequent lecture.
